name: docker/bake/image
description: OCI image built from a Dockerfile, parameterized through docker-bake.hcl (docker buildx bake)

registry.description: registry prefix for the image tag, no trailing slash; exported to steps as REGISTRY (the bake.hcl variable reads it)

image.description: image name; exported to steps as IMAGE (the bake.hcl variable reads it)

tag.description: image tag; exported to steps as TAG (the bake.hcl variable reads it) — set it in smith.yml params or override per project

build.description: Build the image with docker buildx bake

push.description: Build and push the image via docker buildx bake --push
